entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to return something? I'm just so lost with all of this. It's these shoes I bought.
I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I don't know. A preference, I guess? They just hurt my feet so much. I tried to install the cleats, but I'm not sure I did it right, and after one ride I got these awful blisters. I just don't think they're for me.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes caused blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your name and email address, please?
Sure, it's Alex Smith, a-l-e-x dot smith at email dot com. I was hoping I could just get a refund. The whole process is so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. I'm happy to help. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered 49 days ago.
Is that bad? I don't remember what the policy said. I get so confused reading all the fine print.
Not at all. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? That's a relief. So, what do I do now? Do I have to fill out a form on the website?

No need, I can handle it right here for you. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I've just sent it to your email. All you need to do is pack the shoes in their original box, attach that label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued.
Wow, okay. I can do that. Thank you so much, Diana. You made that so much easier.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
